_note: Exotic VFX templates. Each is a clone of a stock folder in ReplicatedStorage.Assets.VFX.VehicleTemplates, scaled at install time. Stock sizes (measured live 2026-10-02): EngineJet flame beams 10-11 wide tapering to 2, 10 long, fire particles up to 1.5; BoostJet beams 20 to 5, 15 long, particles up to 2.26; StabiliserJet five jets in a row 8 studs wide, each beam 8 to 2, 3 long, particles about 1.
_scales: beamWidthScale: Beam Width0/Width1. particleSizeScale: ParticleEmitter Size. lengthScale: attachment Z offsets, Beam CurveSize, particle Speed and Acceleration, light Range, Trail lengths. lateralScale: attachment X and Y offsets. Set lengthScale = beamWidthScale = particleSizeScale = lateralScale for a plain uniform scale.
_why: VehiclePreviewVFXClient only treats the exact names EngineJet, BoostJet and StabiliserJet as custom-toggle templates. For any other template name it drives Beam widths from the Width0Min/Max and Width1Min/Max attributes and emitter Rate from RateMin/RateMax. The stock effects carry stale width attributes (0.55 and 0.055), so the installer rewrites those attributes to the scaled property values (Min = Max). Without that an Exotic flame would be 0.55 studs wide whatever the Beam says.
